Commentary.Commentary: With the lead of 137, Afghanistan will come out high on confidence and with the pitch deteriorating this lead will be a huge booster. Join us in a while for Afghanistan's second innings.

Liton Das, Mominul Haque and Mosaddek Hossain. Only this trio put on some fight and if not for them Bangladesh might have found themselves following on in this Test. There was little to no resistance from the Bangladeshi batsmen.  Taijul did offer to some support to Mosaddek but was dismissed in the very first over of the day.

Brilliant bowling display from the visitors. Everyone who bowled did really well and it has been a collective effort from this young Test playing nation. The skipper, Rashid Khan led from the front getting a 5-wicket haul to his name. He was well supported by the other bowlers. Apart from Zahir Khan everyone else had a wicket to their name with Nabi getting a 3-fer in his last Test.
Rashid Khan, Afghanistan's talismanic captain leads his side off the field becoming the first Afghanistan player to get a 5-wicket haul in Test cricket.

OUT! LBW! The skipper Rashid Khan becomes the first player from Afghanistan to take a five-fer in Tests. Excellent bowling performance from him and it has helped the visitors take a huge lead of 137 runs on this wicket. Coming to the ball, Rashid bowls a googly around off, Nayeem does not pick it and attempts to leave the ball after getting down on one knee. The ball goes on to hit the front pad. Afghan players appeal and the umpire gives it out. Hasan immediately goes for a review which seems in desperation. The replays roll in and Hawk Eye shows three reds. With that, Bangladesh have been bowled out for 205.

LBW appeal taken upstairs. Nayeem Hasan is the man in question. He has been adjudged LBW but he has taken it upstairs. It looked out to the naked eye but it seems like an hopeful referral by the youngster.
Flatter delivery on middle, Nayeem defends it out.
Fullish delivery on middle, Nayeem manages to defend it back to the bowler.
Another full delivery on middle, Hossain defends it to covers and crosses over for a single.
Full delivery on off, Mosaddek defends it to the off side.
Flatter delivery on middle, Nayeem plays it to square leg.
Looped up ball on middle, Nayeem blocks it out.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full delivery on middle, Mosaddek works it to the leg side for a single.
Flatter delivery on middel, Mosaddek flicks it to short leg.
Loopy delivery on middle, Mosaddek defends it back to the bowler.
Loopy delivery on off, Nayeem attempts to defend but it goes off the outside edge towards third man for a couple.
EDGED AND FOUR! Rashid bowls a flighted delivery on middle and leg, Nayeem looks to flick but gets an inside edge which rolls towards the fine leg fence.
Flighted delivery on middle, Nayeem flicks it uppishly but it falls short of the short leg fielder.
BEATEN! Legspinner around off, Nayeem looks to defend but fails to put bat on it.
Another flat delivery outside off, Nayeem leaves it alone.
Flatter delivery on off, Mosaddek defends it to point and takes a single.
Rashid Khan to partner Nabi. Can the skipper take a 5-fer and end the innings in this over itself?
Full delivery on middle, Mosaddek plays it to long on and takes a single to keep strike for the next over. Excellent first over from Nabi.
Loopy delivery down the leg side, Mosaddek looks to flick but fails to put bat on it.
Loopy delivery on middle, Nayeem attempts to defend but goes off the inside edge towards square leg . The batters take a quick single.
Nayeem Hasan is the last man in.

OUT! Bowled! Excellent start to the day for the visitors.  Taijul fails to add to his overnight score here. Nabi bowls a loopy delivery on off, Taijul goes for a hoick in the first over of the day and misses. The ball goes on to hit the stumps. This shot was not needed at all so early on in the day. He needed to support Mosaddek and get as close as possible to Afghanistan's score. But he went for glory but the only place he has gone with that is back to the pavillion. Nabi gets his third and he is having a farewell Test to remember so far.
Loopy ball on middle, Islam blocks it out.
Nabi starts with a loopy delivery on off, Taijul defends it off the front foot.

We are all set to begin. The Afghanistan players are out in the huddle before they take their respective positions in the field. Overnight batsmen, Mosaddek Hossain and Taijul Islam walk out to continue their innings. Mohammad Nabi to start the day with the ball.

PITCH REPORT - Tino Mawayo is down with the pitch report. Mawayo starts by informing us about the weather. He says that it is a different weather than the previous day as there are lot of dark clouds and also informs us that it rained a bit overnight. Mawayo reminds us that there were a lot of balls that kept low and the batsmen will need to play with their bat down. On the surface, he says there has been a lot of rough on the pitch which has been created by Ahmadzai. Tells with Bangladesh needing to chase in this game on this pitch it will be a tough task.

Trail - 148, wickets in hand - 2, current partnership - 48. That's where Bangladesh will start Day 3 from. The hosts had a terrible day with the bat yesterday and at one stage it looked like they would struggle to even get to 200 but the duo of Mosaddek and Taijul have taken them to a total of some parity. Their job is not done and they would look to continue the fight and reduce the deficit even further. Afghanistan were excellent with the ball yesterday but this batting pair has annoyed them. Rashid Khan and co. will look to get rid of the tail quickly and build on a big lead. The question is how big will the lead be? Another exciting day of Test cricket awaits us. Welcome to the coverage of Day 3 of this one-off Test between Bangladesh and Afghanistan.
... Day 3, Session 1 ...

So that is it from Day 2. Another day of Test cricket to remember for Afghanistan as they continue to defy the odds and dominate this Test. Bangladesh would hope that Mosaddek Hossain and Taijul Islam can continue their fight and take them as close to Afghanistan's total as possible. Will Bangladesh be able to get near the Afghan total or will visitors wrap them up quickly and build on the big lead? Join us on Saturday, 7th September at 1000 Local (0400 GMT) for the start of Day. Till then, take care!

When the hosts came out to bat, they were caught in a defensive web. No strokes were being played and the Afghan spinners were allowed to be on top. Liton Das and Mominul Haque tried to show some fight but eventually were consumed by the pitch. Mosaddek has definitely shown some grit and has got some support from Taijul. The deficit is under 150 but the last 2 wickets would need to add at least 100 to get their side into some sort of contention.

Starting the day at 271/5, Afghanistan lost Asghar Afghan and Afsar Zazai pretty early and at that stage, Bangladesh would have harboured hopes of a collapse but a Rashid Khan blinder delayed proceedings. With 342 on the board, it looked a bridge too far for the home side and the batting showed.

Day 1 was about Afghanistan fighting hard. Day 2 has seen them nearly crush Bangladesh under immense pressure. Getting close to 350, then reducing the hosts 8 down before 150 - well, it has been their day.

In the gap again! Full and outside off, Mosaddek lunges again, this time to defend and gets another edge which escapes the close-in vultures and finds its way through third man. Two runs to the total. STUMPS ON DAY 2, BANGLADESH 194/8, TRAIL BY 148!
Full and outside off, Hossain lunges to drive but gets an outside edge. It sneaks past second slip and he earns another brace to third man.
Full and wide outside off, driven through backward point, past first slip for a couple. A second slip is now employed.
Outside off, solidly blocked out.
Full and down the leg side, Mosaddek misses his flick.
Outside off, solidly defended.
FOUR! Well, surprises never cease! Full and outside off, with 7 balls left in the day, Taijul looks for some adventure. Goes downtown and clears mid on. Was that necessary at this stage?
Goes right back in his crease and blocks.
Full and around off, well pushed out.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Landed outside off, Taijul reaches out to defend but the ball takes the outside edge. Luckily for him, the ball does not carry to first slip who dives to his left.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
Rashid Khan again. 17-3-42-4 so far.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Floated outside off, this is the wrong 'un, let through once more.
Full and outside off, let through.
Landed outside off, left alone.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Huge LBW shout, but not out. Landed outside off, spinning in, Taijul goes back to cut but misses. He is hit on the gloves as Afghanistan appeal but there is no pad involved.
Zahir Khan returns. 7-0-40-0 so far.
Full and outside off, pushed towards mid on.
Landed outside off, Mosaddek pads it away. The batsmen take a single but then a dead ball is signalled.
Outside off, watchfully defended.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Down the leg side, Mosaddek lets it turn past him. The keeper misses and the batsmen take a couple of byes.
Full and outside off, pushed through cover for a single.
Another short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for a run.
Outside off, punched to the off side.
FOUR! THUMP! A short ball, outside off, Taijul swivels and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary!
Around off, blocked to the off side.
Full and wide outside off, Taijul slashes hard but misses.
Around off, solidly defended.
Floated outside off, driven straight to cover.
Full and outside off, pushed back to the bowler.
Around off, defended from the crease.
Full and around middle, flicked through mid-wicket but straight to the fielder.
Down the leg side, flick shot missed.
A bit of a delay. Mosaddek is having some issue. Short leg is sorting it out. Possibly, something to do with the batter's helmet.
Nice gentle full toss outside off, driven straight back to the bowler.
Another change. Mohammad Nabi to bowl now. 20-5-52-2 so far.
Landed outside off, played straight to point.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a single.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Outside off, punched towards cover.
FOUR! That is a bad ball. Short and down the leg side, Mosaddek swivels and pulls it past fine leg for a boundary!
Short and outside off, Mosaddek looks to cut but gets a bottom edge to the off side.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Full and around middle, Taijul lunges and blocks.
Full and outside off, watchfully blocked out.
Outside off, left alone.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full on middle, pushed towards long on for a single.
Rashid Khan is back on.
Wide outside off, left alone.
Full and outside off, Taijul hangs his bat out at that but the ball moves away, takes the outside edge and lands short of first slip.
Around off, blocked from the crease.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a run.
Down the leg side, tickled towards fine leg for a single.
Full and down the leg side, Mosaddek misses his flick but misses and is hit on the pads. Afghanistan appeal but it is sliding down the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Yamin Ahmadzai returns. 7-2-9-1 so far. Loses his run-up. Not really. Mosaddek is not happy with some movement behind the bowler's arm.
Outside off, pushed through point for a couple.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Outside off, steered through point for a run.
On middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and outside off, Mosaddek comes down the track and skews it over cover. Two runs taken.
An LBW appeal. Turned down. Islam looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. Going down leg.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Down the leg side, Islam misses out on the flick.

Down the leg side, Taijul looks to pull but misses.

Outside off, left alone.
Full and around off again, Taijul looks to defend but the ball goes off the inner half and beats short leg.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Jumps out again and smashes it down the ground for a single.
Full and outside off, Mosaddek comes down the track and hits it straight but finds the bowler.

Full and on middle, watchfully blocked out.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Issue with the ball. Rashid is not happy with the shape or it getting wet by going on the outfield. The umpires get it changed.
Full and outside off, pushed past silly point for a quick one.
Down the leg side, flicked through fine leg for a run.
Full on middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.

Wait! The players are being made to wait out there as the rain seems to have stopped and the covers are being taken off again. The same thing happened earlier in the day and it has been repeated here again.
OHH NO! It has started to rain and the covers are coming on.
A short ball, spinning in, Taijul looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. Qais appeals for LBW but it is turned down. Too high perhaps.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Around off, watchfully played out again.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Taijul Islam replaces Mehidy Hasan into the middle.

OUT! Bowled around his legs! Maiden Test wicket for the leggie. Full and outside leg, Mehidy got down to paddle but he misjudged the line and the length. He missed it and the ball hit the middle stump. Qais celebrates.
Full delivery on middle, Mehidy blocks it out.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Floated on off, Hossain looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.

DROPPED! Tough chance but should have been taken. Floated around off, Mosaddek looks to run it down to third man. He is late in his shot and the ball goes to the keeper off the face of the bat. The ball goes sharply to Afsar Zazai, he fails to hold onto it. Rashid is disappointed as he was just inches away from a fifer.
Floated on off, Hossain defends it off the front foot.

Tossed up on off, Hossain defends it off the front foot.
Flighted on off, Mehidy keeps it out.

Gem of a ball! Gives the ball air on off, Mosaddek goes chasing after it but misses.
On the pads, Mehidy glances it towards square leg for one.
Floated on middle and leg, Mehidy looks to flick but gets hit high on the thigh pad.
Leg spinner pitching outside off, Mehidy strokes it with the spin towards point.

Drinks Break! Another good period of play for Afghanistan here. They have managed to pick up two further wickets and are into the tail. Bangladesh counterattacked after the Tea break and have lost Mominul Haque and Mahmudullah in the process. The hosts would look to bat till Stumps without any further loss of wickets. Afghanistan, on the other hand, are three away from wrapping up the innings and would hope to take the wickets quickly.
BEATEN! Beautiful bowling from Rashid. Bowls a flatter delivery on middle, Hossain looks to defend but gets beaten due to the spin on it.
Flighted delivery on middle, Hossain flicks it to the leg side.
Loopy ball on middle, Mosaddek defends it off his front foot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Flatter delivery on middle, Hossain flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a couple. The visitors cannot enforce the follow on now as the trail is below 200. Doubt that Rashid would have enforced the follow on here though.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Lovely! Makes his wrist work like a magic. He pitches on off, Mehidy looks to defend but is comprehensively beaten.
Another good ball. This is pitched just outside off, Hasan reads it well and leaves it alone.
Nicely bowled leg spinner this. Gives it air and pitches it on off, Mehidy defends it with the spin towards point.

Full delivery on middle, Hasan blocks it out.
Flatter delivery around off, Hasan guides it to the point region.
Short delivery on middle, Hasan defends it off the back foot.

FOUR! Good shot from Mehidy. It is a flighted delivery on middle, Hasan gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts this towards the long on fence. It looked like it was off the slice but he had played it nicely.
Full delivery on middle, Mehidy defends it back to the bowler.

On middle, Mosaddek strokes it to mid on.

Another sharp spinner. This is on off, Mosaddek looks to flick but gets a leading edge to point.
Peach of a ball this! Gives this one air on off, Mosaddek looks to defend but the ball turns and grips away from him completely outfoxing Hossain and kissing the edge of his bat.
Qais Ahmad has a change of ends.
Maiden for Rashid in his comeback over. Floated on off, Mehidy keeps it out to get through the over unscathed.
Defended off the back foot by Mehidy.
Bowls it short around off, Mehidy waits back and runs it down late towards gully.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Floated on the stumps, Mehidy defends it with proper technique.
Gives it air on off, Mehidy keeps it out.
Slower through the air on off, Mosaddek plays it to mid off.
Floated on off, Mosaddek strokes it to mid off.
The batsman has driven it through mid-on.
Short off spinner outside off, Mehidy gets on his back foot and punches it towards cover for one.
Slower through the air on middle, Hossain nudges it to long on for a run.
Tossed up on the stumps, Mosaddek defends it off the front foot.
Short ball around off, Mehidy gets on his back foot and punches it towards cover.
Floated around off, Mehidy lofts it wide of cover and wide of sweeper cover for a brace.
Flights one on off, Mehidy nudges it to cover for one.
Short around off, Mehidy opens the face of the bat and runs it down to third man for a couple.
Gem of a delivery! Floated on off, Mehidy looks to defend but the ball spins leaps and bounds and beats the outside edge of Mehidy's willow.
Floated on off, Mehidy strokes it to mid off.
Qais Ahmad comes into the attack.

On off,  Mehidy blocks it away.

OUT! Caught! Mominul Haque's fight comes to an end. Nabi has the last laugh! Floated delivery on off, Mominul looks to clear the man at mid on. He does not time it well and does not even get the desired elevation. The ball goes straight to Asghar Afghan. He makes no mistake and this looks like the final nail in Bangladesh innings.
On the pads, Mosaddek turns it to the on side for a single.
Short around off, Mominul punches it towards cover for a single.
Tossed up on off, Mosaddek milks it to long on for one.

FOUR! FIFTY! Thirteenth fifty for Mominul Haque in Tests. It has been a good innings from him so far and he should know the work is only half done. Haque should be looking to convert this into a big one here.  Rashid bowls a full delivery on off, Mominul bends his knee and lofts this towards the long on region for the second boundary of the over. Back-to-back good overs for the hosts as they are looking to play positive cricket against the spinners.
Flatter delivery outside the off stump line keeping a little low, Mominul leaves it alone nicely.
Full delivery on off, Haque defends it off the front foot.
Short delivery on off, Mominul defends this off the back foot.
FOUR! A rare poor ball from Rashid. Bowls a half-volley on middle, Mominul flicks it uppishly towards the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary. Bangladesh have decided to play positive cricket here.
Flatter delivery around off, Mominul defends this off the back foot.

SIX! Bang! This is out of here! Flighted off spinner on middle, Mosaddek uses his feet to perfection. He comes down the track and thrashes it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. Very good over for Bangladesh this! 15 runs off it.
Flighted on middle, Haque milks it to long on for one.
FOUR! Bang bang goes Mominul. Nabi pulls his length back and bowls short around off and middle, Mominul picks the length early and whacks his pull over mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! Mominul has decided to play counterattacking cricket here. Floated delivery on off, Mominul frees his arm and lofts it over covers for a boundary.
Flighted on the stumps, Mominul defends it off the front foot.
On the stumps, Mominul blocks it away.
Short on off, Hossain keeps it out of his back foot.

NOT OUT! Bad review from Afghanistan.Floated outside off, Mosaddek gets on his front foot and looks to defend. He misses and the ball hits him on the front pad. Rashid asks the question but the umpire is not interested. He has a word with the keeper and then signals the 'T'. Hawk Eye rolls in and shows that the impact was outside off. Afghanistan lose both their reviews.
LBW appeal taken upstairs. Mosaddek Hossain is the man in question. This is Afghanistan's last review and the impact looks to be outside off.
Tossed up on off and middle, Mosaddek pushes it to mid on.
This one rises a bit. Short outside off, Mosaddek looks to defend but misses. The pitch is starting to play a few tricks here.
Once again it keeps low. Short and on middle, Hossain does really well to get his bat to the ball.
Mosaddek Hossain is the new man in.

OUT! Bowled! 6th one down for Bangladesh and it looks like they do not have any answers for Rashid Khan. 4th wicket for the Afghanistan captain and boy isn't this little genius leading like a champion. Short on off, it skids off the surface and keeps low. Mahmudullah looks to play it off the back foot but gets completely squared up as the ball does not rise. The off stump is rattled and Bangladesh are looking down and out.

Outside off, Mominul leaves it alone.
On the stumps, Mominul keeps it out.
Short on off, Haque defends it off the back foot.

NOT OUT! Poor review from Afghanistan. Floated delivery on middle and leg, Mahmudullah comes down the track and looks to defend. The ball lobs towards short leg. He takes it on the up and the Afghanistan players are confident they have their man. The umpire though is unmoved and Afghanistan take the review. Replay rolls in and shows that the ball lobbed off his pad and the bat just hit the pads. Afghanistan lose one of their reviews.
Afghanistan have decided to use their review. It is for a catch and Mahmudullah is the man in question.
BYES! This has beaten everyone. Darts one down the leg side, Mahmudullah looks to sweep but misses. The keeper too fails to gather it. The ball runs behind and the batsmen steal two byes.
On the pads, Mahmudullah flicks it towards square leg.
Off spinner on off, Mahmudullah defends it off the back foot.

Beautiful wrong 'un to end the over. It is pitched outside off, Mahmudullah leaves it alone thinking it to be a leg spinner. Luckily for Mahmudullah it does not spin in much because otherwise Mahmudullah would have been back for an earlier shower.
Short again, Mominul punches it to cover for a run. 100 up for the hosts.

Third delivery on the pads, rusty start to the session for Rashid. This is flicked wide of mid-wicket for one.
Once again it is on the pads, Mominul glances it but finds mid-wicket.

FOUR! Risky shot this from Mahmudullah. Comes down the track to this flighted delivery and lofts this over the mid on fielder for a boundary. It just went over the head of the fielder at mid on. There was no shot needed at this stage when the hosts have lost so many wickets. First boundary for Mahmudullah.

We are back for the final session of the day! Afghanistan players make their way out to the middle. Mominul Haque walks out with a new partner in Mahmudullah. Mohammad Nabi to take the ball first up in the final session.
...Day 2, Session 3...

Bangladesh are in big trouble here and are in a desperate need for a partnership. They trail by 254 runs and have half their side back in the hut. Can the hosts find some inspiration or will Afghanistan continue to pile on their misery? Join us after the break to find out.

Afghanistan bowlers were right on the money. They continued from where they left off in the 1st Session and did not allow the hosts to get away with things easily. Just when Liton Das started to break free, the Afghanistan bowlers pegged Bangladesh back by first breaking the slow stand of Sarkar and Das. Then the introduction of skipper, Rashid Khan continued Afghanistan's dominance as he got rid of Das who was starting to look dangerous. The Afghanistan skipper added the experienced and dangerous duo of Shakib and Mushfiqur to his name ending the session with 3 wickets to his name.

TEA! Wonderful session for Afghanistan! They have picked up five wickets for 88 runs which is a huge advantage on this wicket. The hosts are in huge trouble here with their premier batsmen, Shakib Al Hasan and Mushfiqur Rahim back in the hut. After the early loss of Shadman Islam, Soumya Sarkar and Liton Das played cautiously before the gates opened with the fall of Sarkar's wicket. Liton, Shakib and Rahim followed soon after to leave the hosts reeling.

OUT! The soft signal has played a decisive role here and the T.V umpire has gone with that. Quicker and short on top of middle. Mushfiqur gets on his back foot and looks to defend. He does so off the upper half of his bat. The ball hits the boot and lobs up to the right of short leg. Ibrahim Zadran there shows great reflexes and takes a brilliant catch. The Afghanistan players start celebrating but Rahim is going nowhere. Both the umpires get together and take it upstairs with the SOFT SIGNAL AS OUT. Replay rolls in, there is patch of dust popping which makes it difficult to figure whether the ball hit the ground or not. After a few looks the T.V umpire signals OUT on the giant screen. Massive blow this for Bangladesh as the experienced  Mushfiqur Rahim walks back without troubling the scorers. With that, it is Tea on Day 2!

The umpires have gone upstairs for a catch. The SOFT SIGNAL IS OUT. Mushfiqur Rahim is the man in question. If this is out then Bangladesh are in deep, deep trouble. A very tough call this as the dust which popped out is making it very difficult to come to a conclusive decision. Seems like the soft signal will play a decisive role here.
Floated on off, Mushfiqur pushes it to cover.
Mushfiqur Rahim strides out to the middle with his team in deep trouble.

OUT! LBW! Body blow for Bangladesh! They have not just lost their star man and skipper, they have lost one review as well. The Afghanistan skipper gets the better of his counterpart. Smart bowling this, quicker ball pitching on middle. It straightens after pitching. Shakib looks to defend but misses and the ball hits him flush on the front pad. The Afghanistan players put in a loud appeal and the umpire raises the dreaded finger. Shakib takes the review straightaway. Replay rolls in and Ultra Edge shows there is no bat involved. Hawk Eye then rolls in and it shows three reds. Shakib has to walk back and Afghanistan are all over Bangladesh like a rash.
LBW appeal taken upstairs. Shakib Al Hasan is the man in question. It looks plumb to the naked eye but let's see what the replays have to say.
Full delivery outside off, Shakib guides it to third man for a couple.
Flatter delivery outside off, Shakib looks to cut but gets an inside edge which goes just past the off stump.
Flighted delivery around off, Shakib defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! Whacked away! Once again Zahir drags it short around off, Mominul gets on his back foot and demolishes the ball with a strong pull through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Tossed up on off, MH keeps it out.
Floated on off, Mominul strokes it to point.

FOUR! Too short and Mominul takes full toll of it. Zahir drags it short around off, Haque gets on his back foot and pulls it wide of deep mid-wicket for a boundary. He did not time it well but timed it enough to get a boundary.
Floated on middle, Mominul lofts it over mid on and gets a couple.
FOUR! Poor ball! It is too full and straight on the pads, Mominul easily sweeps it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
This time gets it past the man at mid-wicket and keeps the strike.
On the pads, Mominul glances it to mid-wicket.
Nicely bowled! Googly pitching on off, Mominul looks to defend but gets beaten as he does not read that one.
Darted on the pads, Haque glances it to the on side.
FOUR! Swept fine! Floated full on leg, Mominul gets down on one knee and sweeps it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Floated on middle, Mominul defends it back to the bowler.
Full toss on off, Shakib plays it back to the bowler. He will be disappointed to miss out on that one as it was there to be hit.
Short ball on middle, Mominul flicks it to square leg and takes a single.
Flighted delivery around off, Shakib cuts it to deep cover for a single.

BEATEN! It is a quicker delivery outside off which kept a little low. Shakib attempts a cut but the ball passes the bat. He is lucky not to edge that one as it just passed the outside edge of Shakib's bat.
Flighted ball on middle, Shakib defends it off the front foot.
Short ball outside off, Mominul cuts it to cover and takes a single.
Zahir Khan is back on!
On off, Mominul plays it to point and takes a single. Good over for Bangladesh here.
Looped up ball around off, Shakib drives this to deep cover for a single.
The batsman has driven it through mid-off.
Loopy ball on off, Shakib blocks it out.
FOUR! Nicely played from Shakib. It is a flighted delivery on off, Shakib guides this nicely past the third man fielder for a boundary. First boundary for him and much needed one for the hosts.
Quicker delivery outside off, Shakib looks to chop it but gets fails to put bat on it. Very close to cut there.
Flatter delivery on middle, Mominul blocks it out.
Loopy ball around off, Mominul pushes it to cover.
Full delivery on off, Mominul drives this to mid off.
Short ball outside off, Haque cuts it but straight to the cover fielder.
Full delivery on off, Mominul pushes it to cover.
Tossed up ball on middle, Mominul defends it off the front foot.

Appeal for an LBW but turned down by the umpire. Floated on middle and off, Shakib looks to sweep but gets a feather on in onto his pads. There is a big appeal but the umpire turns it down. Rashid opts against reviewing it. Good decision from the young skipper as Ultra Edge later on shows that it did indeed kiss Shakib's glove before going onto hit the pads.
Brings out the sweep now. Tossed up on middle, Shakib gets down on one knee and sweeps it fine down the leg side for a couple.
Quicker on the pads, Shakib turns it to square leg.

Ohh! Brilliantly bowled! A pacy googly pitching on off. Shakib has a poke at it with very little foot movement. The ball turns away from the southpaw and just about beats the outside edge of the Bangladeshi skipper's willow. This is turning out to be an interesting battle between the two skippers.
Floated on off, Shakib looks to flick but gets a leading edge which goes to mid off.
On the pads, Shakib flicks it to mid-wicket.
Wait, what is happening here? The covers were about to come on. They came half way in but then they perform a U-Turn and they are going back.
Flighted delivery on middle, Mominul defends this off the front foot.

Quicker delivery on off, Mominul looks to cut but gets an edge onto the pads. Well well, the replays roll in and it shows that it was pad first and then the bat. Hawk Eye shows that the ball was going on to hit the leg stump. Another chance missed by Afghanistan. Will Mominul be able to make use of this opportunity? We will have to wait and watch.
Oh no! Seems like the love story between cricket and rain is about to continue as the groundstaff are getting ready with the covers.
Flatter delivery on middle, Shakib flicks it to the leg side and takes a single. He gets off the mark off his first ball.
Short ball outside off, Haque cuts this to deep cover and takes a single.
Tossed up ball on middle, Haque defends this off the front foot.
Flighted delivery around off, Mominul defends it to point.
Bangladesh skipper and talisman, Shakib Al Hasan walks out to the middle to a huge cheer from the crowd.

OUT! Bowled! The Afghan superstar strikes in the last ball of his very first over. And it is the big fish, Liton Das. Rashid bowls it short and quick on off, Das misreads the length and looks to pull it away. The ball is not short enough. He gets a slight inside edge onto the stumps. Rashid is up and running in joy and why wouldn't he be?  A very unwanted shot from Liton. He won't look back at it fondly. Just when he was starting to get into a scoring groove he has departed. Bangladesh in a spot of bother here.
Leg spinner on middle and off, Liton blocks it.
Quicker on top of middle and off, Das tucks it to mid-wicket.
Drags it short this time around off. Mominul gets on his back foot and punches it through cover-point for one. Played it well there, Haque.
Gives this one air on off, Mominul calmly keeps it out.
Starts with a straighter delivery on off, Mominul defends it off the outer half of his bat.
The skipper, the Afghan star, Rashid Khan finally brings himself on.
Looped up ball on middle, Das defends this off the back foot.
Flighted delivery on middle, Das flicks it to short leg.
Short delivery on middle, Das defends this off the back foot.
Loopy ball on middle, Das flicks it uppishly but it falls short of the mid-wicket fielder.

FOUR! Good shot from Liton! It is a full delivery around off, Liton sweeps it towards the square leg region for a boundary. The fielder in the deep puts a good effort in stopping that, he almost pulls it off but the ball ricochets off his leg onto the ropes. Full marks for the effort there.
Flighted delivery on off, Das defends it off the front foot.
Full delivery around off, Das drives this to deep cover and takes a single.
Short ball outside off, Mominul cuts it to point for a single.
Tossed up ball around off, Mominul looks to drive buts the inside edge of his bat towards the leg side.
Full delivery on off, Mominmul drives this to extra cover.
Low full toss on middle, Das flicks it to mid on and crosses over for a single.
Flighted delivery on off, Das blocks it towards the off side.
Full delivery on middle, Mominul blocks it out.
Looped up ball on middle Haque defends it off the front foot.
Flighted delivery on middle, Das flicks it to square leg and takes a single.
Full delivery on off, Das blocks it out.
Short ball outside off, Haque cuts it to deep cover and takes a single.
Full delivery around off, Haque attempts to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
FOUR! Nicely played! Short around off, Das waits for it and cuts it late through the backward point region and fetches himself a boundary.
On the pads, Das defends it to the on side.
Mominul is off the mark. Short and wide outside off, Haque cuts it wide of point and gets a single.
Nicely bowled! Googly  pitching on middle and leg. Mominul gets on his back foot to play that but misses and the ball hits him on the pads.
Floated on off, Liton nudges it wide of mid on for one.
Tossed up on off, Liton turns it to backward square leg.

BEATEN! Flighted delivery around off, Mominul looks to cut off the back foot but gets beaten due to the spin on it. Excellent over from Nabi comes to an end as he finally managed to break the Sarkar-Das stand.
Shorter ball on middle, Haque defends his first ball off the back foot.
Mominual Haque is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! Nabi finally gets his reward as he was bowling excellently since the beginning of the innings. It is a quicker delivery on middle and leg, Sarkar looks to flick but misses. The ball hits him on the pads and the Afghan players put up a strong appeal. The umpire gives it out immediately. Sarkar knows he is a goner and turns his back immediately. Replay shows why he knew he was out because he was dead in front of the stumps. So Soumya departs after fighting it out in the middle but not capitalizing on it.
Short ball on off, Sarkar blocks it out.
Short ball on middle, Sarkar flicks it off the back foot to short leg.
Full delivery on middle, Sarkar attempts to defend but get an edge towards fine leg for a couple.

DRINKS BREAK! Bangladesh have continued their cautious approach but Liton is starting to go after the bad balls now. Afghanistan to their credit have showed great composure here and have been consistent with their line and lengths not allowing much for the Bangladeshi duo to score off. They though need to find a way to break this stand.
Another full delivery on the off pole line, Das pushes this to cover.
Tossed up ball on middle, Liton defends this off the front foot.
Full ball on the pads, Liton tucks it to mid-wicket.

FOUR! Poor ball from Zahir! Liton is finally looking to up the ante here. First a six in the previous over from Zahir and now a boundary. Short ball on the leg stump line, Liton pulls it hard past the diving square leg fielder for a boundary.
Full delivery around off, Das drives this towards mid off.
Tossed up ball around off, Sarkar drives this nicely towards cover and takes a single.
Looped up ball on middle, Das defends it off the front foot.
Flighted ball on off, Das flicks it to short leg.
Floated ball on off, Das defends it towards the point region.
Loopy ball on middle, Das flicks it towards fine leg for a couple.
Flighted delivery on middle, Sarkar flicks it to deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
Flighted delivery around off, Soumya defends this tentatively but he gets an inside edge towards the first slip fielder.

DROPPED AND SIX! Finally, finally some aggression from this batting duo. It has taken 17 overs for this innings to produce the first boundary of the game and it is a maximum. Floated deliver on off, Liton has enough of the waiting game. He finally lets it loose and gets down on one knee to slog sweep it over mid-wicket fence for a biggie. There was a shouts of catch it and the fielder in the deep gets his hands to it but he cannot keep it in.
Short ball on middle, Das blocks it off the back foot towards the off side.
Loopy ball on middle, Das flicks it to short leg.
Low full toss on off, Das plays it back to the bowler.

Full delivery on middle and leg, Liton attempts to defend but gets hit on the pads. There is a stifled appeal for LBW but nothing from the umpire. Hold on a minute. Afghanistan have missed a trick here. Replay later on shows that the ball hit the boot of Liton first. Hawk Eye shows had Afghanistan taken the review then Das would have been back to the pavilion. How unlucky is the debutant not to get his maiden Test wicket?
Full delivery outside off, Sarkar drives this to deep cover and crosses over for a single.
Full delivery on middle, Sarkar flicks it to square leg and takes a single.
BEATEN! Flighted delivery around off turning away from Sarkar, he looks to defend but fails to put bat on it.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Full delivery on middle, Das sweeps it hard which hits the leg of the short leg fielder. The ball goes on to deep mid-wicket and Das takes a single.
Looped up ball on off, Das defends this off the back foot.
Flatter delivery on middle, Sarkar flicks it to mid-wicket and takes a single.
Short ball outside off, Sarkar rocks back and cuts it to deep cover and takes a single. Good start from the debutant here.
Flighted delivery on off, Sarkar attempts to drive but gets an inside edge towards the bowler.
Tossed up ball on off, Sarkar pushes this to the off side.
Short delivery around off, Das pushes it to deep cover and crosses over for a single.
Flighted delivery around off, Das blocks it off his front foot.
Full delivery on middle. Liton defends this off the front foot.
Debutant, Zahir Khan is introduced into the attack now.
Flighted delivery around off, Sarkar pushes this nicely to cover.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flatter delivery on middle and leg, Sarkar looks to flick but gets hit on the pads. The players appeal but nothing from the umpire. It looked like it is sliding down the leg side.
Loopy ball on off, Sarkar drives this to cover.
Full delivery around off, Liton sweeps it to deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
Flatter delivery on middle, Das blocks it out.
Full around off, Sarkar strokes it to mid off.
Comes 'round the wicket and hits the deck hard around off. Soumya defends it without any fuss.
Short ball outside off, Das pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Good length ball on off, Sarkar tucks it towards mid-wicket against the angle and eases to the other end.
On the fourth stump line, Sarkar lets it carry to the keeper.
Short ball around the body, Das pulls it to backward square leg for a single.
Outside off, Sarkar has nothing to do with it.
Flights one on off, Soumya strokes it to cover.
Loopy delivery on off, Soumya taps it back to the bowler.
Flighted outside off, Sarkar watches it till the end and leaves it alone.
Tossed up on off, Sarkar turns it behind square on the leg side and gets a couple.
Floated on off, Sarkar defends it away.
Short ball but misses the mark as he bowls it down the leg side. Das attempts the pull but misses.
On the pads, Soumya turns it to square leg for one.
Good length ball on off and middle, Liton glances it towards mid on and calls for a quick single. Sarkar responds and they get it with ease.
Das defends it from within the crease.
Once again it is full and targeting the stumps. Liton blocks it.
Full and close to the off stump. Das defends it with a straight bat.

Was there bat involved? Shorter around middle and off, it turns away to the left-hander. Sarkar looks to defend but the ball hits him on the front pad. There is an appeal from the Afghanistan players but the umpire is unmoved. Afghanistan do not take the review. No bat involved but the ball was agonizingly missing the off pole which is confirmed by Hawk Eye later on. Very good decision not to review that.
Flighted around off, Das defends it with soft hands towards point for a single.
Darts one on the pads, Sarkar turns it to the on side for one.
Short again. Das shows aggression and hits it to the right of deep square leg. The fielder in the deep there shoes good technique and cleans it up with a slide. Single taken.
Short around off, Das plays it against the spin towards mid-wicket.
Slower through the air around off. Liton waits and defends it late towards point.
Full outside off, Sarkar goes for the drive but it comes off the lower half of his bat and goes straight to cover. 9 gone, Bangladesh 5 for 1.
Fuller on off, Sarkar defends it onto the ground.
Effort ball from Ahmadzai. A bouncer, the first one of this game. It is around off, Sarkar sways away from it.
This is full and on the line of the off stump. Soumya is in no hurry to score and defends it with a straight bat.
On the fourth stump line, Soumya leaves it alone.
Fuller on off, Sarkar keeps it out.

Another edge but this one goes wide of short leg for a single. Floated on middle, Sarkar looks to defend but does so off the inside edge of the bat. Soumya keeps the strike. End of another tight and tidy over from Nabi.
Tossed up on middle and off, Sarkar looks to defend but gets an inside edge which goes to the left of short leg.
Quicker and straighter outside off, Sarkar reads it well and offers a good leave to it.
Floated on off, Sarkar defends it properly.

EDGED BUT SHORT! Off spinner on off, Sarkar looks to defend but the ball turns away at the last moment. Soumya looks to defend but gets a thick outside edge which falls well short of the man at second slip. He dives in front but still cannot get there.
Flatter and full on the stumps. Sarkar bends his back and keeps it out.
Full delivery around off, Das drives this to mid off for nothing. Another good over from Ahmadzai.
Back of a length delivery on the pads, Sarkar flicks it to deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
On a length outside off, Soumya guides it to gully.
Back of a length delivery on middle, Soumya defends this off the back foot.
Full delivery outside off, Soumya attempts to drive again but gets it off the outer half of his bat towards the bowler.
PLAY AND A MISS! Good length ball outside off, Sarkar attempts to drive but fails to put any bat on it.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On the stumps, Liton blocks it.
Shorter on off, Liton keeps it out.
Floated on off, Liton sweeps it but finds square leg.
Off spinner again around off, Das looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.

NOT OUT! The impact is umpire's call but the ball is spinning too much and Hawk Eye shows that the ball would have gone on to miss the leg stump. Excellent review from Liton Das. Off spinner pitching outside off. Das lunges forward to defend but misses. The ball hits him on his front pad. The Afghanistan players ask the question and the umpire raises his dreaded finger. Liton Das has a chat with a Soumya Sarkar and then signals the 'T'. Replay rolls in and Ultra Edge shows there is no bat involved. Hawk Eye then comes on. Impact is umpire's call but the ball is spinning too much and missing the leg pole.
LBW appeal taken upstairs. Liton Das is the man in question. It looks to be hitting outside the line of the off stump. Let us see what the replays have to say.
Mohammad Nabi to continue.
Good drive but straight to the fielder. Full on off, Sarkar gets on his front foot and drives it hard but straight to the fielder.
Back of a length ball on off, Sarkar defends it off his back foot.
Fuller on middle, Sarkar pushes it to mid on.

First runs of the session. Good length ball angling in from middle and off. Sarkar looks to turn it behind square on the leg side. It goes fine down the leg side off the inside edge of the bat. The fielder from fine leg does really well running to his left and pulling it back before the ropes. Saves two for his side.
Pulls his length back just a hint now. Maintains the line though. Soumya punches it to cover.
Steams in and bowls a full ball close to the off pole. Sarkar calmly defends it.

We are ready to resume! The Afghanistan players make their way out to the middle along with Soumya Sarkar and Liton Das. Yamin Ahmadzai will continue after the break with Soumya Sarkar on strike. Dark clouds are hovering around but no rain for now. Let's hope that it stays that way.
... Day 2, Session 2 ...

It has been Afghanistan that have been on top in majority of the play so far. Can they continue to be on top or will Bangladesh find a way to fight back in this batting friendly track? Join us after the break to find out.

The hosts started the day brightly as they picked up quick wickets of the well-set Asghar Afgan and Afsar Zazai early on in the session but Rashid Khan did not allow the hosts to run away with the advantage as he made sure that the visitors get to a total close to 350 with his quickfire fifty. The hosts bowled really well but they would be disappointed not to wrap up the innings early on.

LUNCH! Solid end to the session for Afghanistan as they have picked up an important wicket of Shadman Islam in the very first over of Bangladesh's innings and have given only one run in the four overs that they bowled in the session.

Shorter and quicker on off, Liton gets on his back foot and defends the ball onto the ground. Das covers the ball with his leg as he feels that the ball might go onto hit the stumps. That will be Lunch on Day 2.
No edge this time as Liton lunges and blocks it.
Quicker around off, Liton looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Flighted on off, Das keeps it out.
Another off spinner on off, Liton strokes it to mid on.
Off spinner on off, Liton plays it with the spin towards mid on.
Good length ball down the leg side, Soumya looks to flick but misses the ball and it goes to the keeper.
On a length outside off, Sarkar lets it go to the keeper.
Good length ball on off, Sarkar defends this towards point.
Good length ball on middle, Soumya Sarkar defends this back to the bowler.
On a length outside off, Sarkar leaves it alone.
Bangladesh get underway! Good length ball around off, Liton looks to defend but gets an inside edge which goes just past the stumps towards fine leg for a single.
On the pads, Soumya turns it to square leg. Maiden from Nabi to begin with.
Flights one on off, Sarkar pushes it to cover.
Floated on the stumps, Soumya keeps it out.
Shorter on off, Soumya keeps it out off his back foot.
On the stumps, Sarkar keeps it out.
Starts with a flighted delivery outside off, Sarkar leaves it alone.

Edged but short. Good length ball close to the off pole. Liton looks to defend it with soft hands but gets a thick outside edge. Luckily for him he plays at it with soft hands and hence the ball falls short of the man at first slip. Excellent start for Afghanistan and Ahmadzai. Wicket maiden to start with.
Full ball on off, Liton defends it off the front foot.
Liton Das comes in to bat at a very early stage of the innings.

OUT! Caught behind! Dream start for the visitors. They would have been looking for an early breakthrough and they have got it in the very first over. Ahmadzai steams in and bowls a good length ball around off. It is in the channel. The ball moves away just a bit. Shadman goes to defend it tentatively and ends up getting a thick outside edge. It goes  dipping low to the left of the keeper. Afsar Zazai corrects his foot movement that was initially going the other way and takes a very good low catch. Early setback for the Bangla Tigers.
Fuller on off, Islam keeps it out.
Misses his line and bowls one down the leg side. Shadman leaves it alone.
Ahmadzai starts with a good length ball around off. He gets a bit of inward shape on this one. Shadman looks to defend but does it off the inner half of his bat onto his pads.
